title: Vercel Deployment & Visualization Enhancements
description: Critical deployment fixes for Vercel serverless environment and major improvements to dashboard visualization capabilities with user-controlled chart types.
highlights: Full Vercel serverless compatibility with native Node.js operations
User-controlled chart type selection in dashboard previews
AI now generates diverse visualization types (pie, doughnut, area, scatter)
Mobile footer component for consistent branding across all pages

items.title: Vercel Serverless Compatibility
items.description: Fixed critical deployment issues preventing the application from running on Vercel's serverless infrastructure.
details: Removed incompatible bun:sqlite import that caused runtime errors on Vercel
Replaced shell commands (unzip, rm) with pure Node.js operations using adm-zip
Fixed file upload directory to use os.tmpdir() instead of read-only project directory
Excel file parsing now works in serverless environment without system utilities
All backend operations now use Node.js native APIs for cross-platform compatibility

items.title: Platform-Specific Binary Dependencies
items.description: Resolved build errors caused by missing native binaries for build tools on Vercel's Linux environment.
details: Added @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu to optionalDependencies for Vite builds
Added lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu for Tailwind CSS v4 compilation
Added @tailwindcss/oxide-linux-x64-gnu for Tailwind's Rust engine
Added @esbuild/linux-x64 to prevent potential Vite build issues
All platform-specific packages now in optionalDependencies for flexible installation

items.title: Chart Type Selector in Dashboard Preview
items.description: Users can now manually change visualization types in the dashboard element preview modal before saving to their dashboard.
details: Dropdown selector with 6 chart types: Bar, Line, Area, Pie, Doughnut, and Statistic
Instant preview updates when switching chart types
Smart data transformation when converting between chart types
Automatic color palette adjustment for pie and doughnut charts
Handles edge cases like converting between stat cards and charts

items.title: Reusable Mobile Footer Component
items.description: Created a consistent footer component that appears across all mobile pages for better branding and user experience.
details: Centralized MobileFooter component for easy maintenance
Automatically displays on all mobile routes
Consistent copyright and branding information
Removed duplicate inline footers from individual pages

items.title: Enhanced AI Visualization Detection
items.description: AI now generates more diverse chart types and respects user intent when specific visualization types are requested.
details: AI can now suggest pie, doughnut, area, and scatter charts (not just bar/line)
User prompts containing 'pie', 'doughnut', 'area', or 'scatter' skip basic heuristics
Falls back to AI recommendation for complex visualization requests
Heuristic detection still handles common cases (time series → line, categorical → bar)
Better balance between speed (heuristics) and flexibility (AI)

items.title: Profile Page Refinements
items.description: Improved user profile display with better organization field handling and cleaner interface.
details: Organization field now always visible, showing 'None' when not part of an organization
Removed redundant 'Dashboard' button from profile page
Cleaner, more consistent profile information display
